title: [finding] `check-dts-references.mjs` is wired into `packages/spec` only — 67 of the 68 builds that run the sibling guard do not run it
body:
Path: P? | 落地后残余 | 把 `check-dts-references.mjs` 推广到另外 67 个已跑 `check-dts-emitted` 的包构建

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat 3 (#18883, session `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`) out of the **#19402 / PR #19434** round, from that dev's own out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only — `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `check-dts-references adoption 68 builds` · `per-package build step rollout` · `chunk-capable multi-entry packages` · `one && link per package.json` · `check-dts-emitted adoption set`.

## What landed, and what did not

PR #19434 (card #19402) wired `scripts/check-dts-references.mjs` into **`packages/spec`'s build only** — the package the card measured, and the one whose partial emission measures at 233 breaking removals. **68** package build scripts already run the sibling guard `check-dts-emitted.mjs`; the other **67** do not run the new one.

## Measured safe today, ⛔ and deliberately not taken

Against a real built closure on the #19402 round, `check-dts-references.mjs` was run from each of the 68 package directories: **68/68 exit 0**. The change is one `&&` link per `package.json`, exactly the shape the sibling guard was adopted in.

⚠️ **The cost is why it was not folded in**: 68 `package.json` edits invalidate **68 turbo build hashes at once**.

⭐ **And the adoption set deserves a reading, not a sweep.** Of the 68, **12 are multi-entry by entry stem** and therefore chunk-capable; the other 56 are single-entry, where the check is a tautological green. That is an argument for keeping the existing adoption set as the population — ⛔ rather than introducing a new hand-maintained list, which is the shape that rots.

⚠️ ⛔ Not measured: whether the 56 tautological greens cost enough build time to matter, and whether any of the 12 has a declared surface the derivation would refuse for a reason unrelated to a partial emission.
